title: Rejected await in try

blocks.md:
## `await` a rejection inside `try`

`await Promise.reject(new Error("lost"))` throws into the async function. `try/catch` works the same as sync throw.

Print `lost` from the catch.

choices.md: Rejects the async function (an exception in that function)

blocks.promptMd: > `readKey()` awaits a rejection `"lost"` and returns that message from `catch`. Print it.

hintLadder.md: try { await Promise.reject(new Error("lost")) } catch (e) { return e.message }

description: A rejected await belongs in try and catch, like a throw.
